name: Sgt. Pruitt
blurb: A tired county deputy. Slow to start a chase, then relentless.

meta.notes: The M1 cop (cops-1). Approved line: "License, registration, and your front teeth." Bust and fine numbers are the M1 starting values; the tuning panel scales the radius and dwell. He rides the base bike, scaled by pursuitSpeedScale when the race config is built. M4 cops-3 (head start) gave him the baton as his starting weapon, which you can snatch off him mid-swing; the baton is a draft, so release builds leave him bare-handed until it goes live, and the race config carries it once buildSimConfig maps startingWeapon.
